name: PCHEM
recent: PCHEM 在 2026 年第三季度恢复盈利，净利 RM179mil，主要受较高售价和较低成本带动。同期，EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间连续多日申报持股变动。
notable: 2026 年第三季度恢复盈利，净利 RM179mil。
EPF 在 10 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。
risks: 新闻提及供应过剩和特种化学品需求疲软可能影响前景。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 RM7,903mil，净利 RM414mil，净利率 5.2%；营收环比增长 12.7%，净利环比增长 3.2%，营收同比增长 22.8%，净利率较上季的 5.7% 略降。

recent_en: PCHEM returned to profit in 3Q 2026 with net profit of RM179mil, driven by higher selling prices and lower costs. Meanwhile, EPF filed multiple consecutive changes in its shareholding from October to November.
notable_en: Returned to profit in 3Q 2026 with net profit of RM179mil.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between October and November.
risks_en: News mentioned oversupply and weak specialty chemicals demand may affect the outlook.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM7,903mil and net profit RM414mil, with a net margin of 5.2%; revenue grew 12.7% QoQ, net profit rose 3.2% QoQ, revenue increased 22.8% YoY, and net margin slightly declined from 5.7% in the previous quarter.
